title: Quality review findings
html:
Quality review findings

Complete a reviewer’s action matrix for a nonissuer audit.

Required responses

fields.label: Action for finding A

options.value: Document procedures, evidence, and the significant judgment
options.label: Document procedures, evidence, and the significant judgment

options.value: Delete the estimate from the file
options.label: Delete the estimate from the file

fields.correct: Document procedures, evidence, and the significant judgment
fields.explanation: The file must support significant judgments and conclusions.

fields.label: Classification considered for finding B

options.value: No deficiency without an actual error
options.label: No deficiency without an actual error

fields.explanation: A reasonable possibility of an undetected material misstatement meets the material-weakness concept.

fields.label: Action for finding C

options.value: Treat all oral discussion as sufficient
options.label: Treat all oral discussion as sufficient

fields.explanation: Oral discussion does not replace a required written communication.

fields.label: Action for finding D

options.value: Finish required review and resolve issues before issuance
options.label: Finish required review and resolve issues before issuance

options.label: Assign the opinion to the client

fields.correct: Finish required review and resolve issues before issuance
fields.explanation: Required quality procedures must precede issuance.

exhibits.title: Review findings
exhibits.html: A: A material estimate conclusion has no documented reasoning. B: A control failure could permit a material misstatement with a reasonable possibility. C: A required written governance communication was only discussed orally. D: A required quality review remains unfinished on the planned issuance date.

exhibits.title: Scope
exhibits.html: Assume the applicable standards require the written communication and engagement quality review described. Evaluate required actions rather than legal liability or a future damages claim.
